description: This file implements TLS-related functionalities for a WebSocket session, including managing TLS parameters, fingerprint storage and migration, and handling server trust challenge during SSL handshake. It defines data structures for TLS params, fingerprint storage with migration from UserDefaults to Keychain, and a WebSocket session class that performs server trust evaluation and fingerprint verification.

classes.name: GatewayTLSPinningSession
classes.description: A WebSocket session class that handles TLS server trust evaluation, including fingerprint verification and optional TOFU (Trust On First Use) logic.

methods.name: loadFingerprint
methods.description: Loads the stored fingerprint for a given stable ID, with migration from UserDefaults if necessary.

methods.name: saveFingerprint
methods.description: Stores the fingerprint for a specified stable ID in the keychain.

methods.name: clearFingerprint
methods.description: Removes the stored fingerprint for a given stable ID from the keychain.

methods.name: clearAllFingerprints
methods.description: Removes all stored fingerprints from the keychain and legacy user defaults.
